annotations.text:
1 — Home, signed out
Log In / Sign Up buttons in the header.

1b — Home, signed in (not yet a member)
Memberships and events stacked full-width; the live map is blurred with a lock badge — unlocks once the visitor becomes a member.

1c — Home, already a member
No slogan, search box, or membership packages — just the full-screen unlock map with a nearest-branch Unlock bar, and a "My Gym" list of recently visited branches below.

2 — Branches
Map-free — search bar plus branch cards stacked below. Book leads to Plan My Workout.

2b — Plan My Workout
24 hourly slots, 5 per row, sticky confirm bar.

7 — My Account
Profile, QR access, stats, membership & account lists.

8 — Get HUMF Card
Card preview stacked above the delivery form.

9 — My Performance
Rings, stat boxes, connect device, My Day, Today's Activities.
